title: Stack Five ceremonial magic program at Wright Field

tellings.quote: I believe there was a program at right Airfield called stack five st5 and they were doing these kind of bizarre magical protocols ceremonial magic

plain: A secret programme called Stack Five, or ST5, ran at Wright Field, a military airfield, and carried out "bizarre magical protocols," what Michels calls ceremonial magic. Michels says this himself, on an episode about a former Pentagon official, as something he believes, without naming a source or saying when it ran. If true, it would mean the military had tried ritual magic as part of its secret work.
